question: What is the central flaw in the Cogito as presented in Week 2B?
related_info: The lecture argues that the subject "I" is already presupposed in "I think" or "I doubt," so the conclusion is circular rather than purely secured.
why_high_yield: High yield because the exam can reframe this as the 'smuggled subject' problem.
source_refs: HUMA2831_Week2_02112026_Slides.pdf - slides 7-8 on the circularity of the Cogito

options.A: It proves too little because it omits all sensation but still sneaks in an enduring "I"
options.B: It depends on excluded middle rather than identity
options.D: It is based on too much empirical evidence
